name: piqeras
description: Countdown and departure vote for the Piqeras trip.

scripts.test: node tools/sync-shared.mjs --check && npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix firebase-rules-tests run test:firestore
scripts.lint: npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.deploy: npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy --project piqeras
scripts.deploy:web: npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project piqeras
